user.title: Set up Stadtwerk Haßfurt haStrom Flex
user.description:
Select your tariff and optionally configure additional costs.

**Note on additional costs:**
You can optionally add additional costs such as the proportional base fee per kWh. Leave the field empty if you only want to use the pure electricity price.

**Examples:**
• Leave empty = No additional costs
• `0.5` = Fixed 0.5 ct/kWh surcharge
• `(210.06 / 365 / 24)` = Annual base fee converted to hourly rate
